title: Exploring TBL1XR1 and NCOR1 Expression in B-cell Lymphoma Subtypes: Interaction With DNA Damage Repair Genes.
authors: Mansoor, Adnan; Akhter, Ariz; Hamidi, Mahboobsadat; Roshan, Tariq Mahmood; Shabani-Rad, Meer-Taher; Stewart, Douglas
one_liner_zh: 该文研究B细胞淋巴瘤亚型中TBL1XR1/NCOR1表达及其与DNA损伤修复基因的关联，属于纯表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIM: B-cell lymphomas are characterized by diverse genetic anomalies affecting B-cell differentiation. To expand targeted therapies, an in-depth grasp of the molecular dynamics in the germinal center (GC) is vital. Transducin beta-like 1 X-linked receptor 1 (TBL1XR1) and nuclear receptor corepressor 1 (NCOR1) are instrumental within the GC, modulating myriad oncogenic pathways. Their prognostic roles in various cancers are established, yet their precise impact on B-cell lymphoma is elusive. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Digital RNA quantification (Nanostring) of previously curated 188 B-cell lymphoma specimens across four subtypes, follicular lymphoma (FL), diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL-NOS), primary testicular lymphoma (PTL), and plasmablastic lymphoma (PBL), was reanalyzed with focus on TBL1XR1 and NCOR1 expression, juxtaposing them with 730 ontogenically linked genes. RESULTS: Notably, TBL1XR1 expression was significantly elevated in the PTL- ABC-subtype versus DLBCL-NOS- ABC-subtype (p<0.001), with no marked disparity in GCB-subtypes between them. The median TBL1XR1 expression was remarkably diminished in FL, yet, intriguingly, GCB-subtypes of DLBCL-NOS exhibited significantly enhanced expression compared to FL (p=0.001). In contrast, NCOR1's expression trajectory was consistent across DLBCL-NOS, PTL, and PBL. A strong inverse correlation between TBL1XR1 and NCOR1 was observed in PBL (p=0.001). Importantly, TBL1XR1's pronounced association with several DNA Damage repair (DDR) genes was noted suggesting influence on DNA repair. TBL1XR1-DDR gene signature was further validated employing a public data set of DLBCL-NOS. CONCLUSION: Our exploratory findings unravel the expression patterns of TBL1XR1/NCOR1 in B-cell lymphoma variants. The TBL1XR1-DDR genes connection offers insights into potential DNA repair roles, paving avenues for innovative therapies in B-cell lymphomas.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：B细胞淋巴瘤以影响B细胞分化的多种遗传异常为特征。为扩展靶向治疗，深入理解生发中心（germinal center, GC）的分子动力学至关重要。转导素β样1X连锁受体1（TBL1XR1）和核受体辅阻遏物1（NCOR1）在GC中发挥关键作用，调节多种致癌通路。它们在多种癌症中的预后作用已确立，但其对B细胞淋巴瘤的具体影响尚不明确。材料/方法：对先前整理的188例B细胞淋巴瘤标本（涵盖四种亚型：滤泡性淋巴瘤（follicular lymphoma, FL）、弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤非特指型（diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, DLBCL-NOS）、原发性睾丸淋巴瘤（primary testicular lymphoma, PTL）和浆母细胞性淋巴瘤（plasmablastic lymphoma, PBL））进行数字RNA定量（Nanostring）分析，重点聚焦TBL1XR1和NCOR1表达，并将其与730个发育相关基因进行对比。结果：值得注意的是，PTL-ABC亚型中TBL1XR1表达显著高于DLBCL-NOS-ABC亚型（p<0.001），而两者在GCB亚型间无显著差异。FL中TBL1XR1的中位表达显著降低，但有趣的是，DLBCL-NOS的GCB亚型相比FL表现出显著增强的表达（p=0.001）。相比之下，NCOR1的表达轨迹在DLBCL-NOS、PTL和PBL中保持一致。在PBL中观察到TBL1XR1与NCOR1之间存在强负相关（p=0.001）。重要的是，TBL1XR1与多个DNA损伤修复（DNA Damage repair, DDR）基因显著关联，提示其可能影响DNA修复。TBL1XR1-DDR基因特征进一步通过DLBCL-NOS的公共数据集得到验证。结论：我们的探索性发现揭示了TBL1XR1/NCOR1在B细胞淋巴瘤变异体中的表达模式。TBL1XR1-DDR基因的关联为潜在的DNA修复作用提供了见解，为B细胞淋巴瘤的创新治疗开辟了途径。
